one_liner: Markets declined broadly with no identifiable catalyst, led by sentiment-driven moves.

drivers.title: Broad Market Decline
drivers.detail: No identifiable catalyst for the decline.

drivers.title: FII/DII Activity
drivers.detail: FIIs were net buyers, DIIs were net sellers.

drivers.title: Sectoral Moves
drivers.detail: Nifty Metal and IT sectors fell sharply.

drivers.title: Global Cues
drivers.detail: Mixed US markets with Dow down, Nasdaq up.

flows_line: FIIs net bought Rs 5,866.78 Cr; DIIs net sold Rs 3,159.9 Cr.
watch_next: Watch ECB President Lagarde's speech and US Unemployment Claims at 23:00 IST.
lesson_seeds: Market sentiment can drive significant moves without clear catalysts.
Sectoral performance can vary widely even in broad declines.
Institutional flows provide insight into market sentiment.
Global market movements can influence local indices.
